verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's first-party docs state that merchants can generate a payment link in the Mercado Pago app or website, with no website needed, and share it anywhere. That matches the no-code, shareable-link story, and quick account opening in minutes supports selling immediately. The evidence is only a brief marketing-level mention. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the dashboard link-creation flow and link options, explicit confirmation that a new account can accept payments immediately, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Online sales without a website. Generate a payment link in the Mercado Pago app or website and share it anywhere.
Abrí tu cuenta en minutos desde el celular.
